steps.title: New Lead
howto: Fill in who needs care, where, how to reach them and who pays. Make this a lead fills most of it from the call.
VA, long-term care and GUIDE families: tick the one payer check that shows.
Book the in-home assessment. The step finishes itself when the booking is in.

checks.label: Client name, phone and town on the lead
Payer known
VA referral or authorization received
Long-term care policy reviewed with the carrier
GUIDE screener done
In-home assessment booked

steps.subject: client

steps.title: Care Assessment
howto: Do the in-home assessment and save it in the Hub (Care tab, Assessments & care plans).
The step finishes itself when the assessment is saved as done.

checks.label: Assessment saved in the Hub

steps.subject: client

steps.title: Assessment Outcome
howto: Pick what was decided at the assessment.
Ready to Start can be picked before the agreement is signed: the client shows Agreement Pending until it is.
Needs Follow-Up and Family Not Ready keep everything and wait for the date you pick, without going late. Cannot Accept closes the journey with your reason.

rule.message: Cannot accept: this journey is closed. The assessment and everything else are kept.

steps.subject: client

steps.title: Client Setup + Billing in AxisCare
howto: Create the client in AxisCare from the profile (More, Create in AxisCare). The Hub checks it read back.
Push the contacts and care tasks from the Hub; the Hub ticks them when AxisCare shows them.

Type the rest into AxisCare: allergies, medications, diagnoses, attributes, pets and directions; then the payer, service and bill rate on the Billing tab. Never type card numbers into the Hub: the family enters payment in AxisCare.
Upload the signed agreement to the client's Documents in AxisCare, then tick it here. AxisCare can't tell the Hub, so your tick is the record.

checks.label: Client created in AxisCare
Client Care Agreement signed and countersigned
Responsible parties in AxisCare
Care tasks in AxisCare
Allergies, medications, diagnoses, attributes, pets and directions typed into AxisCare
Service set up in AxisCare (for example Private Pay, Personal Care)
Bill rate set up in AxisCare
VA authorization number
VA authorized hours per week
Long-term care carrier and policy number
Signed agreement uploaded to the client's Documents in AxisCare

steps.subject: client

steps.title: Confirm Schedule + Caregivers
howto: Agree the final days, times and start date with the family, and write them here.
In Caregiver Matching, the caregiver for the first visit says yes to the real assignment. Shifts still without a yes stay open staffing work; they don't hold up the start.
Flexible Booking Care clients skip this step.

checks.label: Schedule approved by the family
Days, times and start date approved
The first visit's caregiver said yes to the real assignment

steps.subject: client

steps.title: Schedule in AxisCare
howto: Send the schedule to AxisCare from Caregiver Matching, or type it in AxisCare: accepted shifts with their caregiver, the rest as open shifts.
The step finishes itself when AxisCare shows the first visit with its caregiver. Open shifts stay listed below with an owner.

checks.label: The first visit is in AxisCare with its caregiver

steps.subject: client

steps.title: Confirm Start of Care
howto: Call or message the family with the first visit's date, time and caregiver (the caregiver intro unlocks now).
Confirm with the caregiver: date, time, address, how to get in, that they read the care plan, and that the visits show in their AxisCare app.
The Hub can see the visit is assigned in AxisCare but can't see inside the caregiver's app, so their confirmation is the proof.

checks.label: Confirmed first visit (date and time)
Family told the date, time and caregiver
Caregiver confirmed the time, address, entry and care plan, and sees the visits in their AxisCare app

steps.subject: client

steps.title: First Shift
howto: Nothing to tick. The Hub watches the first visit; late and missed clock-ins come to you as their usual cards.
When the first visit has a clock-in and a clock-out, the Hub records the actual first visit date.
steps.subject: client

steps.title: Next-Day Follow-Up
howto: Call the family the day after the first visit (the Hub picks the next day someone covering is working, weekends included).
Anything urgent: tick it and the person on duty right now gets it straight away.
All good: saving finishes Start of Care and the client moves to normal check-ins. A change needed becomes one task; Start of Care still finishes.

fields.label: Did the caregiver arrive as expected?
What needs to change (or the concern)
Something urgent: send it to the person on duty now
